description: We advise companies, investors and financial institutions on the full spectrum of corporate and commercial matters in Bangladesh. Our work covers business formation, corporate structuring, investments, mergers and acquisitions, commercial agreements and complex cross-border transactions, with a focus on protecting our clients’ interests while supporting their long-term commercial objectives.

Our dispute resolution practice represents clients in complex commercial disputes, litigation and arbitration in Bangladesh and internationally. We act for banks, corporations, investors and public-sector organisations before the Bangladesh Supreme Court and arbitral tribunals, combining rigorous legal analysis with strategic advocacy to achieve effective and commercially meaningful outcomes.

We provide sector-focused legal and regulatory advice to businesses operating in highly regulated and rapidly evolving industries. Our lawyers work closely with clients to navigate licensing requirements, regulatory frameworks and government authorities, helping businesses manage legal risk and make informed decisions across complex and changing regulatory environments.

We advise domestic and multinational employers on the legal and regulatory issues that arise throughout the employment lifecycle. Our practice covers workforce structuring, employment agreements, labour compliance, workplace policies, restructuring and disputes, providing practical advice that helps organisations manage their people while meeting their legal and regulatory obligations.

Our international trade and investment practice assists foreign investors, international businesses, trading partners and overseas counsel navigating the Bangladeshi market. We advise on market entry, foreign investment structures, cross-border transactions, trade regulations, project finance and concessions, helping clients understand and manage the legal complexities of doing business across borders.

We advise businesses on protecting, managing and commercialising intellectual property and other intangible assets in an increasingly digital economy. Our lawyers also advise on technology transactions, data and cyber-related matters, digital financial services and emerging regulatory issues affecting technology-driven businesses, helping clients navigate both established and evolving legal frameworks.
